# Reference page with an entry table

Reference mode is a table discipline: a consistent, repeatable format per
entry.

## Entries

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `read` | function | The first table in a body, or None |
| `read_all` | function | Every table, in document order |
| `Table` | class | Headers, rows, and a span |
| `delimiter` | field | The `\|---\|---\|` row, or 0 |
| `stop` | field |  |
